title: New: seven rotator cuff tests, how to do them and how far to trust them
新内容：七项肩袖检查怎么做、能信几分
goals: Perform each of the seven tests: the patient's position, what the examiner does, and what the patient does.
会做七项检查：病人的体位、检查者做什么、病人做什么。
Say what counts as a positive result for each test, and which muscle or condition it points to.
说出每项检查怎样算阳性，指向哪块肌肉或哪种问题。
Quote each test's sensitivity and specificity together with the study, its target condition and its reference standard.
引用每项检查的敏感度和特异度时，连同研究、目标疾病和参考标准一起说。
Explain why a positive Neer or Hawkins-Kennedy result adds little, and why no single test makes the diagnosis.
解释为什么 Neer 或 Hawkins-Kennedy 阳性帮助不大，为什么没有哪一项检查能单独下诊断。

blocks.en: Tuesday's pathway said that a combination of the Hawkins-Kennedy, Neer, Jobe and external rotation resistance tests is useful (BESS 2025), and that no single test can make the diagnosis on its own (Hegedus 2012); it promised a Friday chapter on how each test is done. This is that chapter, though resisted external rotation is not covered here: the external rotation lag sign below is a different test. This week's chapter pairs each cuff muscle with its tests, and today takes one from each row: the empty can for supraspinatus (the chapter also lists the drop arm test), the external rotation lag sign for infraspinatus (also resisted external rotation), the hornblower sign for teres minor, and the belly-press test for subscapularis (also the lift-off test). The full can is a variant of the empty can. Neer and Hawkins-Kennedy are not strength tests of one muscle: they try to bring on pain under the acromion. For each test you get the position, what counts as positive, and the numbers from studies we opened, with the condition each study was looking for.
blocks.zh: 周二的流程说过：Hawkins-Kennedy、Neer、Jobe 和外旋抗阻几项检查组合起来有用（BESS 2025），但没有哪一项能单独下诊断（Hegedus 2012）；各项检查怎么做，留到周五这一章。这就是那一章，不过这里不讲抗阻外旋：下面的外旋滞后征是另一项检查。本周章节把每块肩袖肌和它的检查对应起来，今天每一行各取一项：冈上肌取空罐试验（章节还列了落臂试验），冈下肌取外旋滞后征（还有抗阻外旋），小圆肌取 Hornblower 征，肩胛下肌取腹压试验（还有抬离试验）。满罐试验是空罐试验的变体。Neer 和 Hawkins-Kennedy 不是某一块肌肉的肌力检查，它们是在肩峰下诱发疼痛。每项检查都写了体位、怎样算阳性，以及我们打开核对过的研究数字和该研究针对的目标疾病。

blocks.en: First, how to read the numbers
blocks.zh: 先看懂数字

blocks.en: Sensitivity is the share of people who have the target condition and test positive. Specificity is the share of people without it who test negative. A highly sensitive test seldom misses the condition, so a negative result helps to rule it out; a highly specific test seldom flags people who do not have it, so a positive result helps to rule it in. Both numbers belong to one study. They depend on the target condition (a full-thickness tear is not the same thing as subacromial pain), on the reference standard that decided who really had it (MRI, surgery, or a local anaesthetic injection), and on which patients were examined. That is why every number below comes with its study and target, and why you should compare a test's sensitivity with its own specificity, not with another study's numbers.
blocks.zh: 敏感度是真正有目标疾病的人里，检查呈阳性的比例。特异度是没有这个病的人里，检查呈阴性的比例。敏感度很高的检查很少漏掉病人，所以阴性结果有助于排除；特异度很高的检查很少把没病的人判成阳性，所以阳性结果有助于确认。两个数字都属于某一项研究，取决于目标疾病（全层撕裂和肩峰下疼痛不是一回事）、用来判定谁真有病的参考标准（MRI、手术或局麻药注射），以及检查了哪些病人。所以下面每个数字都带着研究和目标疾病；比较时拿同一项研究里的敏感度和特异度相比，不要拿不同研究的数字互比。

blocks.en: Supraspinatus: empty can and full can
blocks.zh: 冈上肌：空罐试验与满罐试验

blocks.en: Empty can (Jobe test): the arms are raised to 90° in the scapular plane, about 30° forward of the coronal plane, and fully internally rotated so that the thumbs point to the floor. The examiner pushes the arms down and the patient resists (Barnes; Itoi 1999 as described by Katepun 2023). Full can: the same 90° of elevation in the scapular plane, but with about 45° of external rotation (Itoi 1999 as described by Katepun 2023), so that the thumbs point up (Nicolao 2022). Kelly and colleagues proposed this position after recording muscle activity in 11 shoulders: supraspinatus was best isolated at 90° of scapular-plane elevation with 45° of external rotation (Kelly 1996). Test both sides and compare.
blocks.zh: 空罐试验（Jobe 试验）：双臂在肩胛平面（冠状面前方约 30°）抬到 90°，充分内旋，拇指朝向地面。检查者向下压手臂，病人对抗（Barnes；Katepun 2023 转述 Itoi 1999 的做法）。满罐试验：同样在肩胛平面抬到 90°，但外旋约 45°（Katepun 2023 转述 Itoi 1999 的做法），拇指朝上（Nicolao 2022）。Kelly 等在 11 个肩上记录肌电后提出这个体位：肩胛平面抬高 90°、外旋 45° 时，冈上肌最容易被单独检查出来（Kelly 1996）。两侧都做，左右比较。

blocks.en: Empty can (left) and full can (right), seen from the front. The arms are drawn straight out for clarity; in the test they point about 30° forward, into the scapular plane (inset, seen from above). The examiner presses both arms down at the same time.
blocks.zh: 空罐试验（左）和满罐试验（右），前面观。为了看清，手臂画成向两侧平伸；实际检查时手臂向前约 30°，落在肩胛平面（小图，从上往下看）。检查者同时向下压两侧手臂。

blocks.en: What counts as positive: pain or weakness during the manoeuvre (Barnes). Itoi and colleagues scored each test three ways in 143 shoulders, against MRI, looking for a full-thickness supraspinatus tear: pain, weakness, or pain or weakness or both. Weakness was the most accurate reading for both tests: 75% accurate for the full can and 70% for the empty can, a difference that was not significant. Pain came on in 43% of shoulders during the full can and 50% during the empty can, a difference that was also not statistically significant; even so, because the full can provoked less pain, the authors suggested it may be the more useful in practice (Itoi 1999). Read for weakness, the empty can had a sensitivity of 77% and a specificity of 68%, and the full can 77% and 74% (Itoi 1999, as tabulated by Dinnes 2003).
blocks.zh: 怎样算阳性：检查中出现疼痛或无力（Barnes）。Itoi 等在 143 个肩上以 MRI 为参考标准、以冈上肌腱全层撕裂为目标，把每项检查按三种方式判读：疼痛、无力、疼痛或无力（任一项或两项都有）。两项检查都是按“无力”判读最准：满罐准确率 75%，空罐 70%，差别没有统计学意义。满罐有 43% 的肩出现疼痛，空罐有 50%，这一差别同样没有统计学意义；尽管如此，作者考虑到满罐诱发疼痛较少，认为它在临床上可能更好用（Itoi 1999）。按“无力”判读时，空罐敏感度 77%、特异度 68%，满罐 77% 和 74%（Itoi 1999，Dinnes 2003 汇总表）。

blocks.en: A second study gives a different picture because it asked a different question. The ROW cohort examined patients older than 45 with shoulder pain for at least 4 weeks and listed these two tests under supraspinatus tears. A tear counted only when blinded MRI review showed one and the attending physician rated their certainty that the symptoms came from a cuff tear at 50 or more out of 100. There Jobe's test had a sensitivity of 88% and a specificity of 62%, and the full can 70% and 81% (Jain 2017).
blocks.zh: 另一项研究的数字不一样，因为它问的问题不一样。ROW 队列纳入 45 岁以上、肩痛至少 4 周的病人，把这两项检查列在冈上肌撕裂之下。只有盲法阅片的 MRI 显示有撕裂、且主治医生对“症状由肩袖撕裂引起”的把握评分在 100 分中达到 50 分以上，才算有撕裂。这项研究里 Jobe 试验敏感度 88%、特异度 62%，满罐 70% 和 81%（Jain 2017）。

blocks.label: 易混点
blocks.zh: 空罐、满罐的“阳性”要先说清楚按什么判：疼痛还是无力。Itoi 1999 发现判断有没有全层撕裂时，“无力”比“疼痛”准；Barnes 指出，阳性也可能提示合并的肩峰下撞击，所以单有疼痛不等于撕裂。周二那一章引用 AAFP 2008 说过：空罐时患侧比健侧无力，可能是肌腱病，也可能是撕裂。

blocks.en: Pain under the acromion: Neer and Hawkins-Kennedy
blocks.zh: 肩峰下疼痛：Neer 试验与 Hawkins-Kennedy 试验

blocks.en: Neer sign: the patient sits. With one hand the examiner presses down on the clavicle and acromion so that the scapula cannot move; with the other the examiner forcibly elevates the arm in the scapular plane. Pain is a positive sign. Neer test is a second step: about 10 ml of 1% lidocaine is injected under the anterior acromion and the manoeuvre is repeated; if the injection abolishes the pain, the Neer test is positive (Cochrane review, Hanchard 2013, Table 1, describing Neer 1977 and 1983). The plane is not described the same way everywhere: Calis 2000 elevated the arm “at an angle between flexion and abduction”.
blocks.zh: Neer 征：病人坐位。检查者一只手向下按住锁骨和肩峰，不让肩胛骨动；另一只手在肩胛平面用力把手臂抬起来。出现疼痛为阳性。Neer 试验是第二步：在肩峰前部下方注射约 10 ml 1% 利多卡因后重复这个动作；如果注射后疼痛消失，Neer 试验为阳性（Cochrane 系统综述 Hanchard 2013 表 1，引自 Neer 1977 和 1983）。上举平面各处写法不同：Calis 2000 写的是“在屈曲与外展之间的角度”上举。

blocks.en: Hawkins-Kennedy test: with the patient upright, the examiner passively places the shoulder and elbow at 90° of flexion, then forcibly rotates the shoulder inward (internal rotation). Reproduction of the patient's own pain is positive (Hanchard 2013, Table 1, describing Hawkins 1980). The 1980 abstract itself describes the idea behind such signs: forcibly flexing the arm forward so that the greater tuberosity is jammed against the anteroinferior surface of the acromion. It does not mention 90° of flexion, the bent elbow or internal rotation (Hawkins 1980, abstract; the full paper was not opened).
blocks.zh: Hawkins-Kennedy 试验：病人坐直或站立，检查者被动把肩和肘都放到屈曲 90°，然后用力把肩向内旋转（内旋）。复现病人平时的疼痛为阳性（Hanchard 2013 表 1，引自 Hawkins 1980）。1980 年的论文摘要讲了这类体征背后的想法：用力把手臂向前屈，让大结节挤向肩峰前下面；摘要没有提到屈曲 90°、屈肘或内旋（Hawkins 1980 摘要；全文没有打开）。

blocks.en: Neer sign (left, from the side): one hand holds the top of the shoulder down while the other forcibly raises the arm. Hawkins-Kennedy (right, from the front): the upper arm points toward you, flexed to 90°; the forearm starts pointing up and the examiner turns it down and inward. The small drawing shows the start position from the side.
blocks.zh: Neer 征（左，侧面观）：一只手按住肩顶，另一只手用力把手臂抬起来。Hawkins-Kennedy（右，前面观）：上臂朝向读者，即肩前屈 90°；前臂一开始朝上，检查者把它向下、向内转。小图是从侧面看的起始体位。

blocks.en: How accurate: both tests are more sensitive than specific. In 125 painful shoulders, with a subacromial injection as the reference standard, Hawkins had a sensitivity of 92.1% and a specificity of 25.0%, and Neer 88.7% and 30.5% (Calis 2000). Pooled across studies of subacromial impingement, Neer had a sensitivity of 72% and a specificity of 60%, and Hawkins-Kennedy 79% and 59% (Hegedus 2012). So a positive result adds little. A negative result lowers the probability only somewhat: Hegedus 2012 judged the negative likelihood ratio of Hawkins-Kennedy poor, with little effect on ruling impingement out, and in Calis 2000 about half of the shoulders with a negative Neer or Hawkins test (48% and 44%) still had a positive injection test. An earlier pooled analysis found that neither test, on its own, had diagnostic value for impingement (Hegedus 2008).
blocks.zh: 有多准：两项检查都是敏感度高于特异度。在 125 个疼痛的肩上，以肩峰下注射试验为参考标准，Hawkins 敏感度 92.1%、特异度 25.0%，Neer 88.7% 和 30.5%（Calis 2000）。把多项肩峰下撞击研究合并，Neer 敏感度 72%、特异度 60%，Hawkins-Kennedy 79% 和 59%（Hegedus 2012）。所以阳性结果帮不了多少。阴性结果也只能让可能性降低一些：Hegedus 2012 认为 Hawkins-Kennedy 的阴性似然比不好，阴性时对排除肩峰下撞击作用不大；在 Calis 2000 中，Neer 或 Hawkins 阴性的肩里仍有约一半（48% 和 44%）注射试验阳性。更早的一项合并分析认为，这两项检查单独使用都没有诊断价值（Hegedus 2008）。

blocks.label: 易混点
blocks.zh: “Neer 征”和“Neer 试验”不是一回事：征是做动作时痛，试验还要加上肩峰下注射后疼痛消失。Cochrane 综述还列出，Neer 征阳性也见于关节僵硬、不稳、关节炎、钙化沉积和骨病变，所以单凭它不能说就是撞击（Hanchard 2013 表 1）。

blocks.en: The back of the cuff: external rotation lag sign and hornblower sign
blocks.zh: 肩袖后部：外旋滞后征与 Hornblower 征

blocks.en: External rotation lag sign (Hertel 1996): the patient sits and the examiner stands behind. The examiner supports the arm with the elbow bent to 90° and the shoulder raised 20° in the scapular plane, and turns the shoulder out to 5° short of full external rotation. The patient is asked to hold that position; the examiner lets go of the wrist but keeps supporting the elbow (Cochrane review, Hanchard 2013, Table 1, describing Hertel 1996). Collin 2015 describes the same steps and explains the 5°: it allows for the elastic recoil of the tissues. Positive: the forearm drifts back inward, toward the belly; the angle it loses is the lag. In the Cochrane table's account of Hertel, a lag of 5–10° signifies a complete tear of supraspinatus or infraspinatus, and 10–15° a complete tear of both, or a nerve problem. Hertel's own paper could not be opened, so its accuracy figures are not given here.
blocks.zh: 外旋滞后征（Hertel 1996）：病人坐位，检查者站在身后。检查者托住手臂，屈肘 90°，肩在肩胛平面抬高 20°，把肩外旋到比最大外旋少 5° 的位置。让病人保持住；检查者松开手腕，但继续托住肘部（Cochrane 系统综述 Hanchard 2013 表 1，引自 Hertel 1996）。Collin 2015 写的步骤相同，并解释了少 5° 的原因：留出组织弹性回弹的余地。阳性：前臂向内、往腹部方向回漂，回漂的角度就是“滞后”。按 Cochrane 表对 Hertel 的转述，滞后 5–10° 提示冈上肌或冈下肌完全撕裂，10–15° 提示两者都完全撕裂，或者有神经问题。Hertel 原文没能打开，所以这里不写它的准确性数字。

blocks.en: How accurate: the lag sign is specific but often insensitive, and the numbers depend on the target. In 401 consecutive patients (406 painful shoulders), checked at arthroscopy or open surgery, it had a sensitivity of 56% and a specificity of 98% for an isolated full-thickness supraspinatus tear; sensitivity rose substantially when infraspinatus and teres minor were also torn, and the lag grew from 7° for an isolated supraspinatus tear to 26° when the tear reached teres minor (Castoldi 2009, abstract). In 37 referred patients with ultrasound as the reference, it had a sensitivity of 46% and a specificity of 94% for full-thickness supraspinatus and infraspinatus tears; the authors stress that a negative result does not rule a tear out (Miller 2008, abstract). In the ROW cohort, looking for an infraspinatus tear, the version labelled “lag sign at 0°” (the paper does not describe the position) was 10% sensitive and 98% specific, and 21% and 98% for tears of 2 cm or more; the version at 90° was 8% and 100% (Jain 2017). The cut-off matters too: in 100 patients with massive tears, looking for severe fatty infiltration of teres minor, a lag of more than 10° gave 100% and 51%, and a lag of more than 40° gave 100% and 92% (Collin 2015).
blocks.zh: 有多准：滞后征特异度高，但常常不够敏感，而且数字随目标疾病变化。在 401 名连续就诊的病人（406 个疼痛的肩）中，以关节镜或开放手术为准，它对单纯冈上肌腱全层撕裂的敏感度 56%、特异度 98%；撕裂累及冈下肌和小圆肌时，敏感度明显升高；滞后角度从单纯冈上肌撕裂的 7° 增大到累及小圆肌时的 26°（Castoldi 2009 摘要）。在 37 名转诊病人中，以超声为参考标准，它对冈上肌和冈下肌全层撕裂的敏感度 46%、特异度 94%；作者强调阴性结果不能排除撕裂（Miller 2008 摘要）。ROW 队列以冈下肌撕裂为目标时，论文称为“0° 外旋滞后征”的做法（论文没有写具体体位）敏感度 10%、特异度 98%，撕裂 2 cm 以上时为 21% 和 98%；“90° 外旋滞后征”为 8% 和 100%（Jain 2017）。阈值也有影响：在 100 名巨大撕裂的病人中，以小圆肌严重脂肪变性为目标，滞后超过 10° 算阳性时为 100% 和 51%，超过 40° 才算阳性时为 100% 和 92%（Collin 2015）。

blocks.en: Hornblower sign (Walch 1998): Walch's full paper is behind a paywall, so the position comes from two secondary descriptions, which agree on the start but word the positive differently. A Korean Shoulder and Elbow Society course handout, citing Patte 1988: the examiner supports the arm at 90° of abduction in the scapular plane, the elbow is bent to 90°, and the patient tries to turn the forearm up into external rotation against the examiner's hand; positive if the shoulder cannot be turned out (Park, course handout). A 2016 review has the patient hold full external rotation in that position; positive if the arm cannot hold it and falls back into internal rotation (Moulton 2016). Collin 2015 uses the same starting position under the name 'Patte test' and grades it by strength, positive below grade 4 of 5; it does not call it the hornblower sign, so its numbers are left out here.
blocks.zh: Hornblower 征（Walch 1998）：Walch 原文需付费，没能打开，所以体位取自两份二手描述；两者起始体位一致，阳性的说法不同。一份韩国肩肘学会的课程讲义（引用 Patte 1988）：检查者托住手臂，肩胛平面外展 90°，屈肘 90°，病人对抗检查者的手，尽力把前臂向上转（外旋）；转不出去为阳性（Park 课程讲义）。一篇 2016 年的综述写的是让病人在这个体位保持最大外旋；保持不住、手臂落回内旋为阳性（Moulton 2016）。Collin 2015 用同一个起始体位，但叫它“Patte 试验”，按肌力分级判读，低于 5 级中的 4 级为阳性；它没有称之为 Hornblower 征，所以这里不引用它的数字。

blocks.en: Left, the external rotation lag sign seen from above: the examiner places the forearm near full external rotation (pale), lets go of the wrist and keeps holding the elbow; in a positive test the forearm drifts back toward the belly, and the angle lost is the lag. Right, the hornblower sign from the front: from the start position with the forearm pointing toward you (pale), the patient turns it up against the examiner's hand.
blocks.zh: 左：外旋滞后征，从上往下看。检查者把前臂放到接近最大外旋（浅色），松开手腕、仍托住肘部；阳性时前臂往腹部方向回漂，丢掉的角度就是滞后。右：Hornblower 征，前面观。从前臂朝向读者的起始体位（浅色）开始，病人对抗检查者的手把前臂向上转。

blocks.en: How accurate: Walch examined 54 patients operated on for combined supraspinatus and infraspinatus tears. The target was stage 3 or 4 fatty degeneration of teres minor (Goutallier grading), which the authors called irreparable; against it the hornblower sign had a sensitivity of 100% and a specificity of 93% (Walch 1998, abstract). A 2016 review quotes these figures as 94% and 100%; we use the abstract's numbers. In the ROW cohort, looking for an infraspinatus tear in patients over 45 with shoulder pain, the hornblower sign had a sensitivity of 17% and a specificity of 96% (Jain 2017). The two results differ because the questions differ: Walch looked for severe fatty degeneration of teres minor in people who already had combined supraspinatus and infraspinatus tears; ROW looked for any infraspinatus tear in a general group of painful shoulders.
blocks.zh: 有多准：Walch 研究了 54 名因冈上肌和冈下肌联合撕裂接受手术的病人。目标是小圆肌 3 或 4 期脂肪变性（Goutallier 分期），作者称之为不可修复；以此为目标，Hornblower 征敏感度 100%、特异度 93%（Walch 1998 摘要）。一篇 2016 年的综述把这两个数字写成 94% 和 100%；本文采用摘要里的数字。ROW 队列在 45 岁以上肩痛病人中以冈下肌撕裂为目标，Hornblower 征敏感度 17%、特异度 96%（Jain 2017）。两组结果差得远，是因为问的问题不同：Walch 是在已经有冈上肌和冈下肌联合撕裂的人里找严重脂肪变性的小圆肌；ROW 是在一般肩痛病人里找任何冈下肌撕裂。

blocks.label: 易混点
blocks.zh: 滞后征和抗阻肌力检查不一样：滞后征是检查者把手臂摆到位，病人只需要保持住；抗阻检查是病人对抗检查者用力。引用滞后征的数字要连阈值一起说：同一批病人，滞后超过 10° 算阳性时特异度 51%，超过 40° 才算阳性时升到 92%（Collin 2015）。另外，Hornblower 征和 Collin 的 Patte 试验起始体位相同，名字不同，数字不要混用。

blocks.en: Subscapularis: the belly-press test
blocks.zh: 肩胛下肌：腹压试验

blocks.en: Gerber and colleagues described the belly-press in 1996 for patients whose internal rotation is too limited for the lift-off test, which needs the hand behind the back. In their words, as quoted in a 2003 review: the patient presses the abdomen with the flat of the hand and tries to keep the arm in maximal internal rotation. If internal rotation is strong, the elbow does not drop backward and stays in front of the trunk. If subscapularis is weak, maximal internal rotation cannot be held, the patient feels weak, and the elbow drops back behind the trunk; the patient then presses on the abdomen by extending the shoulder rather than rotating it inward (Gerber 1996, quoted by Tennent 2003). Later authors add details the quotation does not give. Barth 2006 tested with the arm at the side and the elbow bent to 90°. Tokish 2003 started with the palm on the upper abdomen just below the xiphoid process and counted wrist flexion together with shoulder adduction and extension as positive.
blocks.zh: Gerber 等在 1996 年描述了腹压试验，用于内旋受限、手放不到背后、做不了抬离试验的病人。按 2003 年一篇综述引用的原话：病人用手掌平按腹部，尽量让手臂保持最大内旋。内旋有力时，肘部不会向后落，保持在躯干前方。肩胛下肌无力时，保持不住最大内旋，病人感到无力，肘部向后落到躯干后方；病人改用伸肩而不是内旋来按压腹部（Gerber 1996，Tennent 2003 引用）。后来的作者补充了原话里没有的细节：Barth 2006 让手臂贴在体侧、屈肘 90°；Tokish 2003 让手掌从剑突正下方的上腹部开始，把屈腕加上肩内收和后伸算作阳性。

blocks.en: Belly-press seen from above, the patient facing the top of the page. Left: the patient presses with the elbow kept in front of the trunk and the wrist straight. Right, positive: the elbow drops back behind the trunk and the wrist bends to keep the palm pressing. Wrist bending is part of the positive in Tokish 2003; Gerber's quoted description mentions only the elbow and the shoulder.
blocks.zh: 腹压试验，从上往下看，病人面朝上方。左：病人按压腹部时肘部保持在躯干前方，手腕伸直。右（阳性）：肘部落到躯干后方，靠屈腕才能让手掌继续按压。屈腕是 Tokish 2003 阳性标准的一部分；Gerber 被引用的原话只提到肘部和肩。

blocks.en: How accurate: Barth 2006 examined 68 consecutive patients before arthroscopy, which served as the reference standard; 20 had a subscapularis tear, partial or complete. The belly-press had a sensitivity of 40% and a specificity of 97.9%, and the authors linked a positive result to a tear of at least 30% of the tendon (Barth 2006). Barth counted the test positive if the patient was weaker than on the other side, or pushed the hand into the belly by extending the elbow or the shoulder, so these numbers are not for Gerber's elbow-drop sign alone. Other studies found different sensitivities: 27.8% for any subscapularis tear in 312 patients having arthroscopic cuff surgery (Yoon 2013, abstract), and 73.8%, with a specificity of 75.0%, for any subscapularis tear in the 120 patients in whom the belly-press was analysed, out of 144 having arthroscopic cuff repair (Nair 2025, Table 2). Across the three studies a negative test missed from about a quarter to nearly three quarters of the tears, so a negative belly-press does not rule a tear out.
blocks.zh: 有多准：Barth 2006 在 68 名连续的病人关节镜检查前做了检查，以关节镜为参考标准；其中 20 人有肩胛下肌撕裂（部分或完全）。腹压试验敏感度 40%、特异度 97.9%；作者认为阳性提示肌腱至少 30% 撕裂（Barth 2006）。Barth 的阳性标准是：与对侧相比无力，或靠伸肘、伸肩把手压向腹部；所以这组数字不是只按 Gerber 的“肘部后落”判读的。其他研究的敏感度不一样：在 312 名接受关节镜肩袖手术的病人中，对任何肩胛下肌撕裂的敏感度只有 27.8%（Yoon 2013 摘要）；在 144 名接受关节镜肩袖修补的病人中，有 120 人纳入腹压试验分析，对任何肩胛下肌撕裂的敏感度 73.8%、特异度 75.0%（Nair 2025 表 2）。三项研究里，检查阴性而漏掉的撕裂从约四分之一到将近四分之三不等，所以腹压试验阴性不能排除撕裂。

blocks.label: 易混点
blocks.zh: “抬离试验”这个名字指的东西不止一种：Gerber 1991 的抬离是病人主动把手背从背上抬起来；Gerber 1996 的“抬离”是检查者把手臂被动放到身后最大内旋的位置再松手，看病人能不能保持住，实际上是滞后征（Tennent 2003）。腹压试验常用于因为疼痛或活动受限做不了抬离试验的病人（Tokish 2003）。Tokish 2003 在 16 名健康志愿者身上测肌电，发现腹压试验更多激活肩胛下肌上部、抬离试验更多激活下部；Pennock 2011 在 20 名健康男性身上没有重复出这个差别。

blocks.en: The seven side by side
blocks.zh: 七项放在一起看

blocks.en: Sensitivity (blue) and specificity (gold) as reported by the studies quoted above. Each row names its study and target condition. Rows from different studies differ in target, reference standard and patients, so compare a test's sensitivity with its own specificity and do not rank the rows. The empty and full can share one study (Itoi 1999), as do Neer and Hawkins-Kennedy (Hegedus 2012).
blocks.zh: 上文所引研究报告的敏感度（蓝）和特异度（金）。每一行都写明研究和目标疾病；来自不同研究的行，目标疾病、参考标准和病人各不相同，所以拿同一行的敏感度和特异度相比，不要给各行排名。空罐和满罐同出 Itoi 1999，Neer 和 Hawkins-Kennedy 同出 Hegedus 2012。

blocks.en: Two patterns run through the studies quoted here. Neer and Hawkins-Kennedy are more sensitive than specific: a positive result adds little, and a negative one lowers the probability only somewhat. The lag signs and the belly-press are the other way round: specific but often insensitive, so a clear positive points to a tear, while a negative does not rule one out. No single test settles the question. The Cochrane review of 33 studies concluded that there is insufficient evidence on which to base the selection of physical tests for shoulder impingement (Hanchard 2013). That fits Tuesday's pathway, which, citing BESS 2025 and Hegedus 2012, recommended a combination of tests rather than any one test on its own.
blocks.zh: 这里引用的研究有两个规律。Neer 和 Hawkins-Kennedy 敏感度高于特异度：阳性帮助不大，阴性也只能让可能性降低一些。滞后征和腹压试验正好相反：特异但常常不敏感，明确的阳性提示有撕裂，阴性却不能排除。没有哪一项检查能单独下结论。Cochrane 系统综述纳入 33 项研究后认为，现有证据不足以据此选择肩撞击的体格检查（Hanchard 2013）。这与周二的流程一致：周二引用 BESS 2025 和 Hegedus 2012，主张把几项检查组合起来用，而不是只靠某一项。

check: In Itoi 1999, which reading of the empty can and full can was most accurate for a full-thickness supraspinatus tear: pain, weakness, or pain or weakness or both?
Itoi 1999 判断冈上肌腱全层撕裂时，空罐、满罐按哪种方式判读最准：疼痛、无力，还是疼痛或无力（任一项或两项都有）？
Weakness: 75% accurate for the full can and 70% for the empty can. The full can provoked pain less often (43% against 50%), so the authors suggested it may be the more useful.
无力：满罐准确率 75%，空罐 70%。满罐引起疼痛的比例更低（43% 对 50%），所以作者认为满罐可能更好用。
Calis 2000 found Hawkins 92.1% sensitive and 25.0% specific. Which result helps more, a negative or a positive one, and why?
Calis 2000 中 Hawkins 敏感度 92.1%、特异度 25.0%。阴性和阳性哪个更有用？为什么？

A negative one, though only somewhat. With high sensitivity few people with the condition test negative, so a negative result lowers the probability of subacromial pain; with low specificity many people without it test positive, so a positive adds little. In the same study about half of the shoulders with a negative Hawkins test (44%) still had a positive injection test, so a negative result does not rule it out.
阴性更有用，但也只是有限地有用。敏感度高，有病的人很少呈阴性，所以阴性让肩峰下疼痛的可能性降低；特异度低，很多没病的人也呈阳性，所以阳性帮助不大。同一项研究里，Hawkins 阴性的肩仍有约 44% 注射试验阳性，所以阴性不能排除。
Set up the external rotation lag sign: where is the arm, what does the examiner let go of, and what is a positive result?
外旋滞后征怎么摆：手臂放在哪里？检查者松开什么？怎样算阳性？

Shoulder raised 20° in the scapular plane, elbow at 90°, turned out to 5° short of full external rotation. The examiner lets go of the wrist but keeps supporting the elbow. Positive: the forearm drifts back inward; the angle lost is the lag.
肩在肩胛平面抬高 20°，屈肘 90°，外旋到比最大外旋少 5°。检查者松开手腕，但继续托住肘部。阳性：前臂向内回漂，丢掉的角度就是滞后。
The hornblower sign was 100% sensitive in Walch 1998 but 17% in the ROW cohort. Why can both be true?
Hornblower 征在 Walch 1998 敏感度 100%，在 ROW 队列只有 17%。为什么两者可以同时成立？

They asked different questions in different patients. Walch looked for stage 3–4 fatty degeneration of teres minor in 54 people operated on for combined supraspinatus and infraspinatus tears; ROW looked for any infraspinatus tear in patients over 45 with shoulder pain.
两项研究在不同病人身上问的是不同的问题。Walch 是在 54 名因冈上肌和冈下肌联合撕裂手术的病人中找小圆肌 3–4 期脂肪变性；ROW 是在 45 岁以上肩痛病人中找任何冈下肌撕裂。
Describe a positive belly-press test in Gerber's words, and say what Barth 2006 found for its sensitivity and specificity.
按 Gerber 的原话描述腹压试验阳性，并说出 Barth 2006 的敏感度和特异度。

Maximal internal rotation cannot be held, the patient feels weak, and the elbow drops back behind the trunk; the patient presses by extending the shoulder instead of rotating it inward. Barth: sensitivity 40%, specificity 97.9%, with arthroscopy as the reference.
保持不住最大内旋，病人感到无力，肘部向后落到躯干后方；病人改用伸肩而不是内旋来按压。Barth：以关节镜为参考标准，敏感度 40%、特异度 97.9%。
take: Each cuff test has a position, a positive criterion and, in each study, a target condition. Read the empty and full can for weakness; treat a positive Neer or Hawkins-Kennedy as weak evidence, and a negative one as lowering the probability only somewhat; treat a clear lag sign, hornblower sign or belly-press as strong evidence of a tear. In general painful shoulders a negative one does not rule a tear out, although in patients already known to have combined or massive tears a negative hornblower sign (Walch 1998) or lag sign (Collin 2015) made severe teres minor degeneration unlikely. Quote every number with its study and target.

每项肩袖检查都有体位、阳性标准，以及每项研究各自的目标疾病。空罐、满罐按无力判读；Neer 或 Hawkins-Kennedy 阳性只是弱证据，阴性也只能让可能性降低一些；滞后征、Hornblower 征或腹压试验明确阳性是撕裂的有力证据。在一般肩痛病人中，阴性不能排除撕裂；但在已知有联合撕裂或巨大撕裂的病人中，Hornblower 征阴性（Walch 1998）或滞后征阴性（Collin 2015）提示小圆肌严重变性的可能性很小。引用每个数字都要带上研究和目标疾病。
bridge: Next: the muscles these tests load work in two force couples; say them aloud from memory. 下一章：这些检查加负荷的肌肉在两组力偶里协作，凭记忆把它们讲出来。

title: Consolidate: force couples and scapulohumeral rhythm, said aloud
夯实：力偶与肩肱节律（凭记忆口述）
goals: Say from memory how the deltoid and the rotator cuff together raise the arm while keeping the humeral head centred.
凭记忆讲出三角肌和肩袖怎样一起抬臂，同时让肱骨头保持居中。
Name the three parts of the scapular upward-rotation couple, with where each one pulls, in which direction, and its nerve.
说出肩胛骨上旋力偶的三个部分，以及各自拉在哪里、朝哪个方向、由哪条神经支配。
Trace the deltoid, lower trapezius and serratus anterior from origin to insertion, with the nerve.
从起点到止点讲出三角肌、下斜方肌和前锯肌的走行，并说出神经。
Describe arm elevation in three overlapping stages and explain why 2:1 is only an approximation.
按三个相互重叠的阶段讲手臂上举，并说明为什么 2∶1 只是近似。
Predict what happens to elevation when one partner in a couple is weak.
推断力偶中某一方无力时，上举会出现什么变化。

blocks.en: This chapter turns the movement section of this week's chapter into speaking practice. Every fact here comes from library/shoulder: section 3.2 with figures 10 and 11, the muscle records, section 3.3 with figure 12, and the clinical card on muscle imbalance. Nothing new is added, except one marked link to chapter 1's empty can and full can tests at the end. For each prompt, look away from the page, say the answer aloud in English, then open the reference and compare. If you would rather draw, sketch it and compare with figure 06 or 07.
blocks.zh: 这一章把本周章节“动作配合”一节变成口述练习。所有内容都取自知识库肩部章节：3.2 节和图 10、11，肌肉记录，3.3 节和图 12，以及“肌肉失衡与动作表现”这张临床卡片，没有加入新东西，只在末尾加了一处标明的联系，指向 01 章的空罐和满罐试验。每道题先移开视线，用英文大声说出答案，再展开参考答案对照。想画也可以：画出来后对照图 06 或图 07。

blocks.en: Two force couples
blocks.zh: 两组力偶

blocks.en: At the glenohumeral joint, the deltoid and rotator cuff work together to elevate the arm while controlling the position of the humeral head. At the scapula, the upper and lower trapezius work with serratus anterior to produce upward rotation during arm elevation.
blocks.zh: 在盂肱关节，三角肌与肩袖协同抬臂，并控制肱骨头的位置。在肩胛骨，上、下斜方肌与前锯肌协作，在上举过程中产生肩胛骨上旋。

blocks.en: The two couples, redrawn from the chapter's figures 10 and 11 with the same pulls, directions, nerves and axes (the origin–insertion panels are left out). Left: the deltoid pulls the humerus up; supraspinatus presses the head toward the glenoid; infraspinatus, teres minor and subscapularis pull it down and in. Right: three pulls on the scapula turn it into upward rotation; the chapter's figure 11 marks the early axis near the root of the spine, and the late axis is at the acromioclavicular joint.
blocks.zh: 两组力偶，按章节图 10、11 重画，拉力、方向、神经和旋转轴与原图一致（省略了起止点对照栏）。左：三角肌把肱骨往上拉；冈上肌把肱骨头压向关节盂；冈下肌、小圆肌和肩胛下肌把它往下、往内拉。右：三个拉力让肩胛骨上旋；章节图 11 把早期旋转轴标在肩胛冈根部附近，后期旋转轴在肩锁关节。

prompt: Shoulder joint: how do the deltoid and the rotator cuff work together as the arm rises? Say what each one pulls and in which direction, and what would happen if the deltoid acted alone.
盂肱关节：手臂上举时三角肌和肩袖怎样配合？说出各自拉什么、朝哪个方向，以及三角肌单独作用会怎样。
answer: The deltoid pulls the humerus upward; acting alone, it would move the humeral head up toward the acromion. Supraspinatus compresses the head toward the glenoid, and infraspinatus, teres minor and subscapularis pull the head inferomedially, down and in. Together they elevate the arm while controlling the position of the humeral head, which stays centred beneath the acromion.
三角肌把肱骨往上拉；如果单独作用，会让肱骨头向肩峰方向上移。冈上肌把肱骨头压向关节盂，冈下肌、小圆肌和肩胛下肌把肱骨头往下、往内拉。合起来，它们在抬臂的同时控制肱骨头的位置，让它保持在肩峰下方的中间。

prompt: Scapula: name the three parts of the upward-rotation couple. For each, say where it pulls, in which direction, and which nerve supplies it. Then say where the axis of rotation lies early and late in elevation.
肩胛骨：说出上旋力偶的三个部分，每个拉在哪里、朝哪个方向、由哪条神经支配；再说旋转轴在上举早期和后期分别在哪里。
answer: Upper trapezius, supplied by the accessory nerve: a superomedial pull on the acromion and lateral clavicle. Lower trapezius, also the accessory nerve: an inferomedial pull on the root of the scapular spine. Lower serratus anterior, supplied by the long thoracic nerve: a lateral and anterior pull on the inferior angle. Together they produce upward rotation of the scapula during arm elevation. In the chapter's figure 11 the early axis is marked near the root of the spine; the late axis is at the acromioclavicular joint.
上斜方肌，副神经支配：把肩峰和锁骨外端往上、往内拉。下斜方肌，同样是副神经：把肩胛冈根部往下、往内拉。前锯肌下部，胸长神经支配：把肩胛下角往外、往前拉。三者合起来，在手臂上举时让肩胛骨上旋。章节图 11 把早期旋转轴标在肩胛冈根部附近，后期旋转轴在肩锁关节。

blocks.en: Drawing instead: sketch a right scapula from behind, add the three arrows with their nerves, mark the two axes, and draw a curved arrow for the rotation. Then compare with the right half of figure 06.
blocks.zh: 如果用画的：从后面画一块右肩胛骨，加上三个箭头和各自的神经，标出两个旋转轴，再画一条表示旋转的弧形箭头。画完对照图 06 右半边。

blocks.en: Trace the muscles from memory
blocks.zh: 凭记忆讲出肌肉走行

blocks.en: Each answer is the chapter's course sentence, then its nerve and the action that matters here. Say all of it: origin, path, insertion, nerve.
blocks.zh: 每个参考答案都是章节里的走行句，再加神经和这里用到的动作。要完整说出：起点、走向、止点、神经。

prompt: Trace the deltoid: origin, path, insertion, nerve with its segments, and which part contributes strongly to abduction.
讲出三角肌：起点、走向、止点、神经和节段，以及哪一部分是外展的重要参与者。
answer: The deltoid originates from the lateral third of the clavicle, the acromion, and the spine of the scapula, passes toward the humerus as its fibers converge, and inserts onto the deltoid tuberosity of the humerus. It is supplied by the axillary nerve, mainly C5–C6. The middle, or acromial, part contributes strongly to arm abduction.
三角肌起自锁骨外侧三分之一、肩峰和肩胛冈，肌纤维向肱骨汇聚走行，止于肱骨三角肌粗隆。由腋神经支配，主要为 C5–C6。其中部，即肩峰部，是手臂外展的重要参与者。

prompt: Trace the lower trapezius: origin with its vertebral levels, direction of travel, insertion, nerve, and its role in the scapular couple.
讲出下斜方肌：起点和椎体节段、走行方向、止点、神经，以及它在肩胛骨力偶中的作用。
answer: The lower trapezius originates from the spinous processes of the lower thoracic vertebrae, commonly described as T4–T12, passes superolaterally, and inserts onto the scapular spine near its medial end. It is supplied by the accessory nerve (cranial nerve XI); the anterior rami of C3–C4 are usually described as proprioceptive. Its fibers work with the upper trapezius and serratus anterior to produce upward rotation of the scapula during arm elevation.
下斜方肌起自下部胸椎棘突（常描述为 T4–T12），向上外侧走行，止于肩胛冈内侧端附近。由副神经（第十一对脑神经）支配；C3–C4 脊神经前支通常被描述为本体感觉纤维。它与上斜方肌和前锯肌协作，在手臂上举时产生肩胛骨上旋。

prompt: Trace serratus anterior: origin, how it reaches the scapula, insertion, nerve with its segments, and which fibres help upward rotation.
讲出前锯肌：起点、怎样到达肩胛骨、止点、神经和节段，以及哪部分纤维参与上旋。
answer: The serratus anterior originates from the lateral surfaces of the upper eight or nine ribs, passes around the thoracic wall, and inserts onto the anterior, or costal, surface of the medial border of the scapula. It is supplied by the long thoracic nerve, C5–C7. Its inferior fibres attach near the inferior angle and contribute to upward rotation.
前锯肌起自上八或九根肋骨的外侧面，绕过胸壁，止于肩胛骨内侧缘的前面（肋面）。由胸长神经支配，C5–C7。其下部纤维附着于下角附近，参与肩胛骨上旋。

blocks.en: Scapulohumeral rhythm
blocks.zh: 肩肱节律

blocks.en: Arm elevation combines glenohumeral motion with scapulothoracic motion. The familiar 2:1 ratio is a teaching approximation, not a fixed ratio at every angle. Scapular motion varies with the task, the plane of elevation, and the individual.
blocks.zh: 手臂上举结合了盂肱关节活动和肩胛胸壁活动。常见的 2∶1 是教学概括，并不是每个角度都恒定不变的比例。肩胛骨运动会随任务、上举平面与个体而变化。

blocks.en: The chapter's figure 12, unchanged. At 30° the motion is mostly glenohumeral (the setting phase); at 90° it is about 60° glenohumeral plus 30° scapular, and at 180° about 120° plus 60°. The chapter cites Inman (1944) and Bagg and Forrest (1988) for the rhythm.
blocks.zh: 章节图 12，原样使用。30° 时以盂肱运动为主（定位期）；90° 时约为盂肱 60° 加肩胛 30°，180° 时约为 120° 加 60°。章节对肩肱节律引用的是 Inman（1944）和 Bagg 与 Forrest（1988）。

prompt: Describe elevation from 0° to 180° in three overlapping stages. For each, say what the glenohumeral joint and the scapula are doing and which muscles contribute.
把 0° 到 180° 的上举分成三个相互重叠的阶段来讲：每个阶段盂肱关节和肩胛骨在做什么，哪些肌肉参与。
answer: 0–30°, initiation and positioning: supraspinatus and deltoid contribute to initiation of elevation; the rotator cuff helps stabilise the humeral head while the scapular muscles position the scapula. 30–90°, coordinated upward rotation: glenohumeral and scapular motion occur together; trapezius and serratus anterior contribute to scapular upward rotation, and the clavicle also moves. 90–180°: continued scapular upward rotation and posterior tilt, together with humeral external rotation and clavicular motion. These are overlapping contributions rather than isolated on-off stages.
0–30°，起动与定位：冈上肌与三角肌参与上举起动；肩袖帮助稳定肱骨头，肩胛肌群调节肩胛骨位置。30–90°，协同上旋：盂肱关节与肩胛骨活动相互配合；斜方肌与前锯肌参与肩胛骨上旋，锁骨也同时运动。90–180°：肩胛骨持续上旋、后倾，以及肱骨外旋和锁骨运动。这些作用相互重叠，并不是彼此孤立、依次开关的阶段。

prompt: A classmate says the shoulder always moves 2° at the glenohumeral joint for every 1° of the scapula. Answer them, using the numbers in figure 07.
同学说肩关节每个角度都是盂肱 2° 配肩胛 1°。用图 07 的数字回答他。
answer: 2:1 is a teaching approximation, not a fixed ratio at every angle; scapular motion varies with the task, the plane of elevation and the individual. In figure 07 the first 30° is mostly glenohumeral, the setting phase. The about-2:1 split describes the totals at 90° (60° plus 30°) and at 180° (120° plus 60°).
2∶1 是教学概括，不是每个角度都恒定的比例；肩胛骨运动随任务、上举平面和个体而变化。图 07 里前 30° 以盂肱运动为主，是定位期。约 2∶1 指的是 90°（60° 加 30°）和 180°（120° 加 60°）时的总量。

blocks.en: When one partner is weak
blocks.zh: 力偶中一方无力时

prompt: Predict what you would see in each case: (a) serratus anterior is weak; (b) the upper trapezius is overactive and the lower trapezius is weak; (c) the rotator cuff is weak.
推断每种情况会看到什么：(a) 前锯肌无力；(b) 上斜方肌过度活跃、下斜方肌无力；(c) 肩袖无力。
answer: (a) Insufficient scapular upward rotation, scapular winging and difficulty elevating the arm. (b) The person compensates by shrugging the shoulder. (c) Rotator cuff weakness involves the deltoid–rotator cuff force couple, upward movement of the humeral head, the subacromial space and pain.
(a) 肩胛上旋不足、翼状肩胛和上举困难。(b) 出现耸肩代偿。(c) 肩袖无力涉及三角肌—肩袖力偶、肱骨头上移、肩峰下间隙与疼痛。

blocks.en: Chapter 1's empty can and full can tests load supraspinatus, one of the cuff muscles in the first couple; a weak result there is the clinical side of answer (c). That link is ours; the chapter states only the force-couple facts above.
blocks.zh: 01 章的空罐和满罐试验给冈上肌加负荷，冈上肌属于第一组力偶中的肩袖。那里查到无力，就是上面 (c) 在临床上的表现。这个联系是我们加的，章节只写了上面这些力偶事实。

blocks.note: 01 章每项检查的做法、阳性标准和准确性数字都取自页末列出、为本包实际打开核对的来源；原始论文没能打开的地方，正文写明了用的是谁的转述。图 01 至 04 是新画的体位示意图，图 05 只画正文引用的数字。02 章的事实全部取自本周章节（library/shoulder 的 3.2、3.3 节，图 10 至 12，肌肉记录和临床卡片），没有加入新事实；末尾与 01 章空罐、满罐试验的联系是我们加的，已在正文标明；图 06 按章节图 10、11 重画，图 07 是章节图 12 原图。

check: Which muscle in the glenohumeral couple would, acting alone, move the humeral head up toward the acromion?
盂肱关节力偶中，哪块肌肉单独作用会让肱骨头向肩峰上移？
The deltoid. The rotator cuff counters it: supraspinatus compresses the head and the other three pull it down and in.
三角肌。肩袖与它对抗：冈上肌压住肱骨头，另外三块把它往下、往内拉。
Which two parts of the scapular couple share a nerve, and what is it?
肩胛骨力偶里哪两部分是同一条神经支配？是哪条？
Upper and lower trapezius, both supplied by the accessory nerve (cranial nerve XI).
上斜方肌和下斜方肌，都由副神经（第十一对脑神经）支配。
Where does the lower serratus anterior pull, and in which direction?
前锯肌下部拉在哪里，朝哪个方向？
On the inferior angle of the scapula, laterally and anteriorly.
拉在肩胛下角，方向向外、向前。
In figure 07, how much of the 90° is glenohumeral and how much is scapular?
图 07 中，90° 里盂肱和肩胛各占多少？
About 60° glenohumeral and 30° scapular, which is about 2:1.
take: Two couples raise the arm together. At the glenohumeral joint the deltoid lifts the humerus while the cuff keeps the head centred; at the scapula the upper and lower trapezius (accessory nerve) and lower serratus anterior (long thoracic nerve) turn it into upward rotation. Elevation combines glenohumeral and scapulothoracic motion in overlapping stages, and 2:1 is an approximation, not a rule.
两组力偶一起把手臂抬起来。在盂肱关节，三角肌把肱骨往上抬，肩袖让肱骨头保持居中；在肩胛骨，上、下斜方肌（副神经）和前锯肌下部（胸长神经）让它上旋。上举结合了盂肱关节活动和肩胛胸壁活动，按相互重叠的阶段完成；2∶1 是近似，不是定律。
